new_entities.name: SmscrReview
new_entities.description: A quarterly SM&CR conduct monitoring and accountability review record. Tracks the review lifecycle, findings, and Board reporting. Owned by SVC-015 (Compliance Core, CAP-005).

fields.name: review_id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this SM&CR review

fields.name: triggered_by
fields.description: FK to PER-059 who triggered the review

fields.name: conduct_alerts_count
fields.description: Number of conduct alerts identified by surveillance scan

fields.name: training_completion_rate
fields.description: Percentage of staff completing required FCA conduct training

fields.name: accountability_changes_count
fields.description: Number of accountability map changes since last review

fields.name: fca_register_updates_required
fields.description: Whether FCA register updates were required

fields.name: breach_notification_ref
fields.description: FCA breach notification reference (if status = breach_notified)

fields.name: smf16_attestation_ref
fields.description: Head of Compliance attestation reference for review sign-off

fields.name: closed_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp when review was closed

design_decisions: SmscrReview is a simple governance record. No cross-capability dependencies needed.
